body:
Added mail_account_credentials table (AES-256-GCM encrypted password at rest), local_uid linking on mailbox creation, reveal-password admin endpoint, and WebmailHandler auto-connect fallback so an admin-provisioned mailbox just works for the user with zero manual connect step. Commits IDUNA_PRO 4de6c3c, CarePyre 5150171.

⚓ ☃
title: Mail happy path: admin-provisioned mailboxes auto-connect webmail, revealable password
